# CodingBoyBlah

> CodingBoyBlah (Anshuman) is a full-stack developer and creative technologist based in India. He builds open-source applications, experimental interfaces, and web tools.

## About
- Name: Anshuman (CodingBoyBlah)
- Role: Full-Stack Developer & Creative Technologist
- Website: https://boyblah.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/codingboyblah
- Twitter / X: https://x.com/boyblahdev
- Itch.io: https://codingboyblah.itch.io

## Core Projects
- **Musique**: Fast, lightweight open-source Spotify desktop client. (https://musique.boyblah.dev/)
- **vynl**: Spotify analytics web application tracking listening habits and music trends over time. (https://boyblah.dev/vynl)
- **Posters**: Graphic design and visual typography poster collection. (https://boyblah.dev/posters)
- **Circle Pong**: Experimental circular paddle game published on itch.io. (https://codingboyblah.itch.io/circle-pong)

## Writing & Blog Posts
- [What Building vynl Taught Me](https://boyblah.dev/blog/vynl): Reflection on project planning, Spotify API limits, and shipping open-source software.
- [Who am I?](https://boyblah.dev/blog/whoami): Personal background, evolution from Python to Godot to JavaScript, and developer philosophy.
